method_selection: Content: TF-IDF full/title-tags or SVD logistic C=.1/1; CF: ItemCF or LogisticMF d4/8 r5. Select each family on current-run validation NDCG, then blend selected CF/content with alpha .25/.5/.75. Exactly four exported methods.
retrospective_status: Existing test already inspected in prior studies; rerun is a controlled refactor, not new independent confirmation
purpose: Offline recommendation on existing crawl metadata and collaborator synthetic logs

identity.current: run plus raw user ID; item response models also separate per run
identity.historical: single-initialisation assumption, exploratory only; never merge with current IDs
identity.sensitivity: historical user scoped by server day; assumption stress, not verified truth

label: positive = not blocked and not skipped and completion >= 0.8
secondary_label: positive = not blocked and not skipped and (like or share)
pair_policy: first valid received event per cohort/user/video; retain all cleaned events separately

split.method: global received-time cutoffs within each simulation cohort

catalogue: static retrospective metadata union; per-cohort observed catalogue; no claim of historical availability

evaluation.primary_scope: current runs with known initialisation boundaries
evaluation.ranking: all cohort catalogue items excluding prior first-exposure train/validation pairs
evaluation.relevance: held-out logged positives only; unobserved candidates are unjudged
evaluation.selection: mean validation NDCG@10 across current run cohorts, equal cohort weight

test_policy: selection snapshot written before reading test response files; no retuning on test
integration: offline snapshot and CLI only; serving tables/API/web deferred
